en: Contact damping of the floating slab
name: Contact damping of the floating slab

designations.text: Contact damping of the floating slab

complete_examples.text: The maximum Z vibration level of the tunnel wall shows a nonlinear variation with an increase in contact damping of the floating slab, with the minimum value occurring at a damping value of 0.15 MN·s/m3.

The results indicate that the damping of the fasteners has smaller impact on the vertical acceleration of the vehicle body, rail displacement, and floating slab displacement compared to the contact damping of the floating slab.
